    Walmart stores will be open on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026
    , operating during their regular business hours. While many retailers close, Walmart remains open to serve customers. It is recommended to check your local store hours, as some locations may vary. 
    Key 2026 Easter Weekend Info: 
    • Walmart: Open regular hours (typically 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.).
    • Sam's Club: Closed.
    • Target: Closed.
    • Costco: Closed.
    • Other options: CVS, Walgreens, and some grocery stores like Whole Foods are generally open. 
    It is always a good idea to confirm hours for specific departments, such as the pharmacy or auto center, through the Walmart store locator.
